limitations: Supported only by n <= 10 with orders 8 and 10 undecided within budget (both laws in 5, 7, 9; out 2, 3, 4, 6); the small models are idempotent quasigroups. Weak evidence; recorded to direct the next search.
statement: The finite models of x = y(x((yx)y)) (ETP 677) and of x = y(((yx)x)y) (ETP 1313) have exactly the orders 1 and the odd integers n >= 5.
title: Laws 677 and 1313 have spectrum {1} together with all odd n >= 5
